mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, concurrent_login_enabled, max_devices, remember_me_enabled, idle_seconds, absolute_seconds, remember_idle_seconds, remember_absolute_seconds, password_expiry_enabled, password_expiry_days, audit_retention_days, version FROM public.iam_tenant_security_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
SELECT security_version FROM public.iam_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_tenant_security_policy SET concurrent_login_enabled = #{request.concurrentLoginEnabled}, max_devices = #{request.maxDevices}, remember_me_enabled = #{request.rememberMeEnabled}, idle_seconds = #{request.idleSeconds}, absolute_seconds = #{request.absoluteSeconds}, remember_idle_seconds = #{request.rememberIdleSeconds}, remember_absolute_seconds = #{request.rememberAbsoluteSeconds}, password_expiry_enabled = #{request.passwordExpiryEnabled}, password_expiry_days = #{request.passwordExpiryDays}, audit_retention_days = #{request.auditRetentionDays}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{request.version} AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.iam_tenant SET security_version = security_version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, tenant_id, event_type, payload_json, status, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT 'tsp-' || md5(#{tenantId}::text || ':' || #{securityVersion}::text || ':' || account.id::text), 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', account.id::varchar, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED', jsonb_build_object( 'tenantId', #{tenantId}::varchar, 'accountId', account.id::varchar, 'securityVersion', #{securityVersion}::varchar, 'actionNameSnapshot', '租户安全策略收紧，强制会话失效', 'usernameSnapshot', account.username, 'displayNameSnapshot', COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) ), 'PENDING', #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND account.is_deleted = false
